RANKED MATCHMAKING BAN
25 Jun, 2019 @ 7:37pm
360NoHijab
As you all know there are many players who intentionally feed and spoil ranked games, especially in the lower MMR bracket. I've been matched with player picking heroes they've never played before like Axe in ranked matches and they don't even know how to call. If u try to teach them, they start flaming. and end up feeding the whole game. There are even people who feed the whole game just cause they didn't get the lane they wanted. And there even players who are simply low life douchebags who enjoy spoiling games.

There should be a report system that bans them from playing ranked matches at least. I know we have a low prio based punishment but that's not enough. I'm not asking for a ridiculous rage driven plea to ban them from the game I'm just saying that there should be a separate report system for ranked matches only banning offenders from playing ranked games based on player reports and taking into account k/d ratio also if it is possible number of couriers killed while being controlled by the offender(That would be your best clue) and each ban should be more punishing then the last. For example :- 1st offense - 15 day ban, 2nd offense - 30 day ban, 3rd offense - 45 day ban and so on. That way we can truly stop ranked matching making abuses. And new players and especially players who buy accounts way above their skill set will learn to practice more in the normal games before they even think about playing ranked. And as for the trollers and intentional feeders, they'll eventually realize that life is too short to be waiting for the ban cooldowns just to spoil everyone's games

Nobody cares about feeders and trollers in normal games, so let them play there and waste their sad life but in ranked we try to work as a team to fight with our enemies and not with ourselves. It's bad enough that we have boosters and smurfs who spoil our games but its downright aggravating when your team mate doesn't even know what game he's playing.

I really wish Valve and the rest of the DOTA2 community would take this into consideration at least and pay attention to the underdogs of DOTA
